<\STATESEP>theory Monads_D
imports
  Types_D
  Monads.Nondet_In_Monad
  Monads.Nondet_VCG
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym 'a k_monad = "(cdl_state, 'a) nondet_monad"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype cdl_except_error = ExceptError<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype cdl_preempt_error = PreemptError<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype cdl_fault_error = FaultError<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym 'a except_monad = "(cdl_state, cdl_except_error + 'a) nondet_monad"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym 'a preempt_monad = "(cdl_state, cdl_preempt_error + 'a) nondet_monad"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym 'a fault_monad =  "(cdl_state, cdl_fault_error + 'a) nondet_monad"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation
  throw :: "(cdl_state, 'a + 'b) nondet_monad" where
  "throw == throwError undefined"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  preemption_point :: "unit preempt_monad" where
 "preemption_point \<equiv> throw \<sqinter> returnOk ()"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  unify_failure :: "('f + 'a) k_monad \<Rightarrow> (unit + 'a) k_monad" where
 "unify_failure m \<equiv> handleE' m (\<lambda>x. throwError ())"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  fault_to_except :: "'a fault_monad \<Rightarrow> 'a except_monad"
where
  "fault_to_except m \<equiv> handleE' m (\<lambda>x. throw)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  option_select :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> ('s, 'a option) nondet_monad"
where
  "option_select S \<equiv>
    if S = {} then
      return None
    else
      select S >>= (\<lambda>a. return (Some a))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  throw_on_none :: "'a option \<Rightarrow> ('e + 'a) k_monad"
where
  "throw_on_none x \<equiv>
    case x of
        None \<Rightarrow> throw
      | Some y \<Rightarrow> returnOk y"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
